hypothesis: Lions are the most social of cats, living in large groups called prides.

source: Saurang atlit nang saraba bisa, macan kawa banaik-naik (maski kada lihai), bakunyung, malacung jarak jauh wan manjuhut lima kali labih kuat daripada kakuatan manusia.

hypothesis: The roar of a tiger is not entirely that of a lion, but more of a snarling, screeching phrase.

source: Ocelot katuju makan binatang halus. Inya cagar manangkap warik, ular, binatang pangarat, wan burung kalo inya kawa. Handak sabarataan binatang nang Ocelot buru ngitu jauh labih halus daripada dirinya.

hypothesis: The ocelot prefers to eat small animals, preferably lizards, snakes, rodents, and birds, which are much smaller than itself.

source: Buhan ilmuwan bapikir kalo ocelot maumpati wan mandapati binatang gasan dimakan (dimangsa) malalui bau, manciumi di mana buhannya barada di atas tanah.

source: Inya kawa malihat dengan jalas dalam kadap lawan panglihatan malam, wan bagarak diam-diam, juwa. Ocelots mamburu mangsanya pakai cara basambunyi di sakitaran imbah tu marungkau mangsanya.
reference: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
hypothesis: They can see clearly in the dark with night vision, and move silently, too.

source: Pas kalumpuk halus makhluk hidup (dalam populasi halus) tapisah matan pupulasi utamanya wadahnya baasal (misalnya inya pindah ka wilayah pagunungan atawa sungai, atawa kalau inya pindah ka pulau hanyar jadi inya ngalih handak babulik) inya cagar rancak marasa ada wadah nang balain matan nang buhannya dahulu.
reference: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
hypothesis: When small groups of organisms (in small populations) become separated from the main population of their place of origin (for example they move to a mountainous or riverine region, or if they move to a new island it is difficult for them to return) they often find themselves in a different place from where they were before.

source: Lingkungan nang hanyar ngini baisi sumber nang balain wan pasaing nang balain, jadi populasi hanyar cagar parlu sifat nang balain atawa manyasuaiakan manjadi pasaing labih kuat daripada apa nang buhannya parlu sabalumnya.
reference: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
hypothesis: These new environments had different resources and different competition, so the new populations either needed different traits or adapted to be more competitive than they had been previously.

source: Populasi awal balum barubah sama sakali, ngitu masih parlu panyasuaian nang sama kaya sabalumnya.
reference: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
hypothesis: The initial population has not changed at all, it still requires the same adjustments as before.

source: Waktu balalu, populasi hanyar mulai manyasuaiakan ka lingkungan hanyarnya, buhannya mulai kurang mehatiakan wan kurang katuju wan populasi nang lain.
reference: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
hypothesis: As the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they become less wary and less tolerant of other populations.

source: Padahal lah, ribuan atawa jutaan tahun nang lalu, dua populasi cagar talihat balain banar nang mana buhannya kada kawa disambat matan spesies nang sama.

hypothesis: In fact, thousands or millions of years ago, two populations of a reservoir would have looked so different that they could not have been the same species.

source: Kami manyambatnya ngini proses manspesialkan, nang cuma baarti mambantuk spesies hanyar. Panspesialan ialah konsekuensi nang kada kawa diabaiakan wan bagian nang penting banar matan evolusi.
reference: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
hypothesis: We call this the process of speciation, which simply means the formation of a new species.

source: Tanaman maulah oksigen nang dihiyut manusia, wan buhannya maambil karbondioksida nang dihambusakan manusia (ngitu pang, bahinak).
reference: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
hypothesis: Plants produce the oxygen that humans breathe, and they take in the carbon dioxide that humans exhale (i.e., breathe out).

reference: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
hypothesis: Although most of their diet seems similar to ours, the Romans also had strange or unusual dishes, including wild boar, birds of prey, snakes, and a variety of land animals called durmus.
